column3: MT 2:5. “A cord of measurement” is rendered “a measuring line.”
MT 2:8. “This young man” is rendered “that young man”; “open regions it will remain” is rendered “will be inhabited without walls,” and “livestock” “cattle.”
MT 2:10. “Alas, alas” is rendered “Ho there!,” and “scattered” “dispersed.”
MT 2:11. “Alas” is rendered “Ho”; “inhabitant of the daughter of Babylon” is rendered “who are living with the daughter of Babylon.”
MT 2:12. “Honor” is rendered “glory,” and “the pupil of his eye” “the apple of His eye”; “to the nations” is rendered “against the nations.”
MT 2:14. “Shout for joy and rejoice” is rendered “Sing for joy and be glad.”
MT 2:15. “Will become for me into a people” is rendered “will become My people.”
MT 2:17. “Hush!” is rendered “Be silent,” and “roused himself” “is aroused.”
